title: Malformed SSE/WS frames degrade to Unknown rather than error — correct frame-isolation policy
description: Both parse_sse_block (sse.rs) and parse_ws_frame (ws/mod.rs) degrade malformed or unrecognized frames to Unknown rather than returning Err. A single bad server frame must not kill a long-lived SSE stream or WebSocket connection; only tungstenite transport errors warrant reconnect. This is the correct behavior per RFC 8887 §4.3.1 (clients SHOULD ignore unknown message types). A contributor might be tempted to return Err on malformed StateChange or Response frames — that would be wrong because it would force reconnect on recoverable server bugs.
